noise_floor_source: The nearest each cell was EVER observed to read across 161 operator-attested EMPTY frames. A return nearer than this is a body; a return between this and the median is the empty room's own spread. A flat 250mm cut sits INSIDE that spread on 42 of 55 cells: at A1 the flat cut is 854mm but the empty room never came nearer than 1063mm, and at C4 it is 1423mm against 1461mm. That is why an empty bathroom intermittently built a body-sized shape and committed STANDING_AT_TOILET.
